stem: At 14:40 a technician realizes that a required observation made at 13:55 was not entered. The technician remembers the observation accurately. Which record best preserves data integrity?
choices: Enter the observation at 13:55 with no indication that the record was created later
Enter the observation using the facility's late-entry process so the original observation time and later entry time remain distinguishable
Skip the entry because late records are automatically invalid
Use the current 14:40 condition as if it were the 13:55 observation
rationale: A late entry can still be useful when the record preserves what was observed, when the observation occurred, when the record was actually entered, and any required reason or attribution. Backdating hides the true record history.
